test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Kolar fields were famous for which of the following minerals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gold mining**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kolar Gold Fields is located in the **Kolar District of Karnataka**.
 
• These mines were nationalized in **1956** and were closed in** 2001** due to environmental setbacks, pricing, and, lack of investments.
 
• It is almost 100 km away from Bangalore and operated by Bharat Gold Mines Limited(BGML).
 
• This is one of the deepest mines in the world. **Mponeng Gold Mine** in South Africa is the deepest mine in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Gold **usually occurs in **auriferous rocks**.
 
• It is also found in the sands of several rivers.
 
• Gold is also accepted as **International Currency**.
 
• **Karnataka** is the **largest producer** of Gold in terms of metal content in India followed by Rajasthan and Bihar.
 
• **China** is the** largest producer** of Gold accounts 11% of the world followed by Australia and Russia.
 
• India ranks **2nd** in Gold imports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diamond Mining**

 
 
• Diamond is the** hardest** **naturally** occurring substance found on Earth.
 
• Diamonds are used in ornaments, polishing the surfaces of metals and in gem cutting.
 
• Reserves of Diamonds have been estimated only in the** Panna belt and Krishna Gravels in Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• **Cutting and polishing** of diamonds are done by modem techniques at important centers like **Surat, Navasari, Ahmedabad, **Palampur, etc.
 
 
 
• **Copper Mining**
 
 
• Copper is a highly** ductile, strong, and good conductor** of electricity.
 
• It is mainly used in electrical machinery, automobile, and stainless steel. When alloyed with zinc, it is known as ‘brass’ and with tin as ‘bronze.
 
• India is a poor country with regard to reserves and the production of copper. India has low-grade copper ore (less than 1% metal content) (international average of 2.5%).
 
• Major copper ore deposits are located in the** Singhbhum district (Jharkhand)**,** Balaghat district (Madhya Pradesh)**, and **Jhunjhunu and Alwar districts (Rajasthan)**.
 
• Madhya Pradesh has become the largest producer of copper in India surpassing Karnataka, Rajasthan, and Jharkhand in succession.
 
 
 
• **Coal Mining**
 
 
• India has the** fourth-largest **coal reserves in the world.
 
• India is the world's** second-largest coal **producer, after China.
 
• Coal is formed by fossils of plants, trees, bushes, etc., deposited in shallow basins million years ago.
 
• The top coal-producing states include** Odisha, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal**, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, and Maharashtra.
 
• Coal is found in 4 varieties --**Anthracite, Lignite, Bituminous, and Peat**.
 
• **Anthracite** is the** best quality** of coal which carries 80 to 95 percent carbon content.
